title: SEPT-ILP lab document v1
description: The single source of truth for one laboratory: a staged scenario of checkpoints built from the shared block vocabulary. A lab document records what the lab says — never how it looks or how a page is produced.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema file.

schemaVersion.description: Lab JSON schema major version this document conforms to.

kind.description: Projects share the lab structure; the renderer labels their checkpoints as phases and omits lab-specific chrome.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the course (e.g. lab-01). Names the output directory and the student-state namespace.

number.description: Ordinal shown to students and used to order the course portal.

summary.description: The hero abstract: what the student will do and why it matters.

cardSummary.description: One-sentence description shown on the course portal card.

chips.description: Short hero facts: software, hardware, core concept, deliverables.

duration.description: Time expectations, stated explicitly rather than buried in prose.

contentVersion.description: Bump when published edits invalidate stored student state (changed keys, changed answers). The runtime resets saved work whose version no longer matches.

items.description: A slide-out reference drawer available from every checkpoint.

icon.description: Icon shown on the drawer's dock button, by Material Symbols name (build, code, menu_book, functions, science, info, bolt, push_pin). An unknown name falls back to a default.

knowledgeTopics.description: Knowledge-base topic ids most relevant to this lab, listed in the lab's support panel. Inline links use kb:<topic-id> targets in rich text.

items.description: One stage of the scenario. Completion is derived from the interactive blocks inside: every quiz answered correctly, every checklist ticked, every non-optional field valid, every ordering solved, every required evidence chosen.

navLabel.description: Short label for the progress bar; defaults to the title.

eyebrow.description: Kicker above the title (e.g. a pedagogical phase: Predict, Build, Measure, Explain).

context.description: Small context badge (equipment or focus, e.g. "A0 sensor + D7 LED").

submission.description: Marks the closing checkpoint: rendered with the submission treatment and hosting the progress-file controls.

submissionRules.description: What must be submitted through the LMS, stated as explicit rules on the final checkpoint.
